d: Mnzil is a fast-growing proptech company in Riyadh providing integrated workforce services (housing, transportation, catering and building operations) across Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

We are looking for a driven, adaptable and creative Marketing Associate to join our growing team. You will help plan and run multi-channel campaigns that build brand awareness, engagement and business growth. You won't just execute tasks: you will own specific projects, analyse performance and bring fresh ideas. This role suits someone who loves a fast-paced environment, can wear multiple hats and thrives with autonomy.
1–3 years of marketing experience; agency or fast-growing startup experience is strongly preferred
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field
Able to juggle multiple projects, shift priorities quickly and meet tight deadlines
High ownership and comfortable working with ambiguity
Familiar with tools such as HubSpot, Hootsuite, Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite and Looker Studio
Canva or Adobe Suite and WordPress/Webflow are a plus
Plan and execute online and offline marketing campaigns, including events that generate leads
Write engaging, on-brand copy for social media, email newsletters and events
Schedule and monitor social media channels, engage with our community and track growth
Run newsletters and basic automated email flows, testing layouts and subject lines
Track and report marketing performance and turn data into quick, practical changes
Work with design, sales and product teams to keep projects moving
Support brand positioning, partnerships and community-building initiatives
